en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, that he said: I was told by al-Mu’adhi, from Mu’ammar, from Abu’l-Hasan, peace be upon him, that he said:
I said to him: What do the people narrate with regards to mud and the dislike of it? He said: That is only with regards to the moisturized, and that is clay.
